mapper.select: select wx_user_id from ${table} where corpid = #{corpid} and wx_user_id = #{wxUserId} and type = #{type}

select t.wx_user_id, t.wx_name, t.wx_dept_id, d.dept_name as wx_dept_name, t.wx_position, t.wx_mobile, t.wx_email, t.wx_biz_mail, t.wx_gender, t.wx_avatar, t.wx_telephone, t.wx_status, t.no_bind, t.last_sync_time from ${userTmpTable} t left join ${deptTmpTable} d on d.corpid = t.corpid and d.wx_dept_id = t.wx_dept_id where t.corpid = #{corpid} and t.type = #{type} and t.status = #{status} order by t.wx_dept_id, t.wx_name, t.wx_user_id

select t.wx_user_id, t.wx_name, t.wx_dept_id, d.dept_name as wx_dept_name, t.wx_mobile, t.no_bind, t.last_sync_time from ${userTmpTable} t left join ${deptTmpTable} d on d.corpid = t.corpid and d.wx_dept_id = t.wx_dept_id where t.corpid = #{corpid} and t.wx_user_id = #{wxUserId} and t.type = #{type} and t.status = #{status}
mapper.insert: insert into ${table} (corpid, wx_user_id, wx_name, wx_dept_id, wx_position, wx_mobile, wx_email, wx_biz_mail, wx_gender, wx_avatar, wx_telephone, wx_status, status, type, last_sync_time, remark) values (#{e.corpid}, #{e.wxUserId}, #{e.wxName}, #{e.wxDeptId}, #{e.wxPosition}, #{e.wxMobile}, #{e.wxEmail}, #{e.wxBizMail}, #{e.wxGender}, #{e.wxAvatar}, #{e.wxTelephone}, #{e.wxStatus}, #{e.status}, #{e.type}, #{e.lastSyncTime}, #{e.remark})
mapper.update: update ${table} set wx_name = #{e.wxName}, wx_dept_id = #{e.wxDeptId}, wx_position = #{e.wxPosition}, wx_mobile = #{e.wxMobile}, wx_email = #{e.wxEmail}, wx_biz_mail = #{e.wxBizMail}, wx_gender = #{e.wxGender}, wx_avatar = #{e.wxAvatar}, wx_telephone = #{e.wxTelephone}, wx_status = #{e.wxStatus}, status = #{e.status}, last_sync_time = #{e.lastSyncTime} where corpid = #{e.corpid} and wx_user_id = #{e.wxUserId} and type = #{e.type}
